_comment: Gemini CLI configuration for this MCP server.
Goes in ~/.gemini/settings.json on the CLIENT machine, or in .gemini/settings.json
inside a project. Fill in the credentials and delete this _comment block --
httpUrl (not url) is the Streamable HTTP transport, which is what this server
speaks. 'url' is the older SSE transport and will not connect.
TWO THINGS THE GEMINI CLI DOCS DO NOT COVER:
1. TLS. This server uses a private CA, so the client must trust it. Gemini CLI
runs on Node, so set NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS to the full path of mcp-ca.pem
BEFORE launching it, or install mcp-ca.cer into the Windows root store.
Without it the connection fails at the TLS handshake, before MCP starts,
and the error will not mention certificates clearly.
2. run_program is the only tool here that can change data. excludeTools removes
it entirely for this client; use it unless that machine genuinely needs to
run Priority procedures. 'trust': false keeps the confirmation prompt on
every tool call and is the default -- do not set it to true on an ERP.
